description: Iteratively substitutes synonymous codons to resolve unwanted restriction sites (domestication for Golden Gate), homopolymers, tandem repeats, predicted secondary structure, cryptic RBS/polyA motifs and hidden alternate-frame ORFs that construct_qc flags — without changing the encoded protein (verified). Does NOT touch premature stops or GC extremes; re-run construct_qc afterward to confirm. A native TypeScript alternative to a constraint-solver sidecar.

avoidEnzymes.description: Enzyme names whose internal sites should be removed (e.g. ["BsaI","BsmBI"] for Golden Gate domestication).

crypticOrfMinAa.description: Minimum peptide length (aa) for a hidden alternate-frame ORF to be flagged.

frameStart.description: 1-based nucleotide where the reading frame begins.

maxPasses.description: Repeat full passes until clean or no further progress.

organism.description: Codon-usage table to prefer among synonymous options.

sequence.description: Nucleotide sequence (raw or FASTA; IUPAC accepted).

name: construct_autofix
title: Construct auto-fix (domestication)
